media.title: AIM 3.0.1415 Windows, 1999
media.creator: AOL / screenshot by Masaaki Shinjo, Impress Watch

observations.observation: A separate instant-message window divides white transcript and composition panes with a compact formatting strip. Blue and red speaker names precede unbubbled text. Gray beveled controls, a dark-blue active title bar, underlined link command, small pixel icons and a visible buddy icon sit beside a narrow grouped presence window. A separate ticker uses bright green text on black; these windows are one released client artifact, not separate counts.

media.creator: AOL / AwayMessages.com tutorial

observations.observation: The gray native dialog separates a label combobox from a multiline message editor; a compact formatting strip sits above a large white inset. A second complete original menu state shows My AIM → Away Message → New Message, plus Edit Profile, stock/news ticker and screen-name commands. The two states count as one released client artifact.
